label: Owners are roles, not people (D6-17); who holds each role at the MSP is unknown (GQ-01). Treatments are proposals for the compliance owner role to accept. No likelihood or impact rating is given because no incident or loss data exists to base one on.

AIR-1.rationale: The structural control (the model cannot choose the lever) is built for triage; the detector is a backstop.
AIR-1.next_step: Extend the lever-choice rule to any new RAG or email path before it ships.

AIR-2.rationale: Per-lever role, scope and four-eyes are built; real Graph permissions are unknown (GQ-08).
AIR-2.next_step: Review the first real app registration's permissions against the lever list before any live use.

AIR-3.rationale: Rules choose the lever and the approver sees the dry-run diff; a right lever with a wrong target is caught only by the human today.
AIR-3.next_step: Build requester verification (C-30) before any R2 or R3 identity lever runs unattended.

AIR-4.rationale: Client-facing text is draft-only and cited from the client's own KB.
AIR-4.next_step: Keep HO-3 (a human sends); re-check citation coverage whenever the reply workflow changes.

AIR-5.rationale: Nothing leaves the machine today; the redaction gate is fixture-tested.
AIR-5.next_step: Confirm each client's data-handling setting with the client before any hosted route is enabled.

AIR-6.rationale: Hosted providers are off, so no provider retains prompts.
AIR-6.next_step: Enable a hosted route only with written retention terms read on the day (C-28, C-43).

AIR-7.rationale: A provider swap is a config change and routing is eval-driven; the residual is low.
AIR-7.next_step: Re-run the routing eval when a provider is added.

AIR-8.rationale: Per-ticket prompts and client-scoped retrieval exist; shared memory and few-shot examples are not built.
AIR-8.next_step: Add a leakage eval before any shared memory or retrieval index is added.

AIR-9.rationale: Timeouts and idempotency are built; rate caps and the kill switch are planned in the map.
AIR-9.next_step: Confirm caps and pause are built and tested before any bulk lever runs.

AIR-10.rationale: Approvals are bound to the exact request; approver sign-in is a mock.
AIR-10.next_step: Validate a real sign-in token in a test tenant before relying on it (U-06).

AIR-11.rationale: Today only the lead approval stands in the way of a help-desk impersonation.
AIR-11.next_step: Build requester verification (C-30); caller identity checks stay human (W-IDM-04).

AIR-12.rationale: Default-deny tools and pinned CI actions exist; the model and package supply chain is only partly covered.
AIR-12.next_step: Vet any MCP server or model file before use and record it in the vendor register (C-43).

extra.risk: Fixture-based ROI figures are read as real savings
extra.how_it_shows: A leader quotes the tracker's hours as money saved at a client.
extra.residual: Every row says fixture-based and the minutes, runs and effort are labelled assumed; a reader can still skip the label.
extra.rationale: Labels on every row and a test that fails if one is dropped.
extra.next_step: Replace assumed inputs with the MSP's own measurements before any figure is shown as a result.

extra.risk: The SOC 2 mapping is read as a certification or an attestation
extra.how_it_shows: A sales page or a questionnaire answer cites the mapping as proof of compliance.
extra.residual: The mapping lists claims and what is not demonstrated; it is not an audit result and no auditor has seen it.
extra.rationale: Wording check in the tests; a Not demonstrated column for every control.
extra.next_step: Have the compliance owner and counsel review before any external use.

extra.risk: Intake scores are trusted over a person's judgement, or gamed through the declared fields
extra.how_it_shows: A submitter understates the effect or leaves out the lever name, and the never-automate check finds nothing.
extra.residual: The never-automate check reads declared lever names and inventory ids only, not free text; a reviewer must re-derive the risk class.
extra.rationale: Scores list the rule that fired; a person approves every intake.
extra.next_step: Review the first real intakes against what was built, and tighten the fields.

extra.risk: Control statuses in the mapping lag behind what was built
extra.how_it_shows: C-34 and C-35 still read planned in map/controls.json after B-94 built a runbook and templates.
extra.residual: The mapping follows map/controls.json by design, so it understates until the wave fold updates the map.
extra.rationale: Understating is the safe direction; the Not demonstrated column names the lag.
extra.next_step: Fold B-92 and B-94 status changes into map/controls.json at the wave exit.
